In 250 words or fewer, share why you are interested in applying data science and AI to Girl Effects mission.
items.answer: I am deeply passionate about leveraging data science and AI to create impactful solutions, particularly in areas that empower vulnerable populations. Girl Effect's mission to use AI-driven chatbots to provide crucial information and support to adolescent girls aligns perfectly with my expertise in LLMs, generative AI, and multi-agent systems. My experience in building reliable, scalable AI solutions, combined with a focus on user safety and ethical AI, makes me eager to contribute to Girl Effect's mission of transforming lives through technology.

items.question: In 300 words or fewer, describe a project you have worked on involving genAI, including the end-to-end delivery process and challenges faced?
items.answer: At Meta, I contributed to the development of a multi-agent LLM system for an advertiser copilot, streamlining campaign management and creative optimization. The project involved building a retrieval layer on Meta's embedding-search infrastructure, modeling advertiser-campaign-audience relationships on a knowledge graph, and fine-tuning Llama models for multi-turn tool-call extraction. Challenges included ensuring low-latency inference, maintaining system reliability, and aligning AI outputs with advertiser needs. The project successfully improved advertiser efficiency and satisfaction, demonstrating the potential of generative AI in complex workflows.
